assets.subject: Frost Wisp, small ice spirit
assets.conceptPrompt:
Concept art of Frost Wisp, small ice spirit for a 3D game asset.
Game style: cozy-spooky storybook, chunky low-poly, cold blue frost lit by warm amber lantern glow. Chunky, rounded low-poly with a storybook feel. The world is cold blues (frosted stone, ice crystals, blue spirit glow); everything warm and friendly is amber (lantern, loot, Brann, stair shafts down). Soft frost rim-light, lantern pool of warm light around the player, darkness beyond. Spooky but never gory: spirits are glowing, translucent and a little cute.
Use only colors close to this palette: night #070b14, deepIce #13243a, stone #3a4352, frost #7fc8f0, rime #d8eefa, amber #ffb347, ember #e86a2c, wood #7a4e2d, spirit #4fe0ff, copper #c9783f.
Simple shapes that read well as a low-poly 3D model.
Full body, standing, limbs clearly separated from the body, nothing overlapping the silhouette.
Single object, centered, on a plain neutral light-grey background.
Front or three-quarter view, orthographic feel: no perspective distortion, nothing cropped at the edges.
Even, soft studio lighting with no heavy or cast shadows (they would get baked into the textures).
No text, labels, frames, watermarks or extra objects.
